item.title: Ocala retains title as No. 1 growth city in U.S., per U-Haul report
item.description: For the second consecutive year, and the third time in the last four, Ocala has been named the No. 1 growth city by the largest DIY moving and rental company in North America. Read more: Ocala retains title as No. 1 growth city in U.S., per U-Haul report

item.title: New calendar pairs Marion County’s first responders with shelter pets to support lifesaving programs
item.description: Marion County Fire Rescue has teamed up with Marion County Animal Services to release a new calendar that pairs local first responders with shelter animals in need of a home. item.title: Peggy Louise Gladyness
item.description: Peggy Gladyness was a proud member of the Red Hatters Society and enjoyed spending time at the Senior Center, where she formed many cherished friendships and participated in outings and trips that brought her great joy. Read more: Peggy Louise Gladyness

item.title: Shopper sues Publix in Ocala after slip-and-fall in bakery
item.description: An Ocala shopper is suing Publix Super Markets for more than $50,000, claiming negligence after slipping on an "unidentified liquid" while walking through the store. Read more: Shopper sues Publix in Ocala after slip-and-fall in bakery

item.title: Nancy Lou Venditto
item.description: Nancy Venditto was renowned for the delicious baked goods she brought to every class party. Her devotion to her children was unmatched. Read more: Nancy Lou Venditto

item.title: ICE protestors gather in Ocala to honor Minnesota woman who was fatally shot by agent
item.description: Protestors gathered in downtown Ocala on Saturday morning to demonstrate their opposition to Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in light of a fatal officer-involved shooting that claimed the life of a 37-year-old Minnesota woman. Read more: ICE protestors gather in Ocala to honor Minnesota woman who was fatally shot by agent

item.title: View of SpaceX Falcon 9 launch over Summercrest in SE Ocala
item.description: Check out this view of the SpaceX Falcon 9 launch on Friday, seen from the Summercrest neighborhood in SE Ocala, which carried 29 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit. Thanks to Douglas Donley for sharing! Read more: View of SpaceX Falcon 9 launch over Summercrest in SE Ocala

item.title: I believe protests have been a foundational American principle since before our country’s inception
item.description: "The Mayflower pilgrims were, in their own ways, engaging in peaceful protests. The British Stamp Act Rebellion, ten years prior to 1776, were engaging in protests. The Declaration of Independence is a protest. The first amendment of the US Constitution is all about lawful protests. Given the long history of American principles, and the total video record of this murder, of an American citizen, without any record of any justification, it would seem you might prefer to live in Russia." - An Ocala
